facts.fact: The Egyptian Cabinet spokesman said the government Payroll system for state administrative-body staff pay had been activated in 2,281 of 2,675 target accounting units, with a further 111 units of economic authorities and bodies moved to the New Administrative Capital also covered.

EGY.note: The document covers the payroll calculation platform for tax and insurance, not how people are paid.
The document is about government payroll and says nothing on health systems.
